intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for two. Enjoy chilled champagne, fresh tropical fruit platters, and breathtaking 360-degree sunset views over the atolls. A quintessential romantic experience perfect for honeymooners.

experiences.name: Snorkeling at Maaya Thila Marine Reserve
experiences.description: Explore one of the Maldives' most celebrated snorkeling and diving sites, teeming with reef sharks, manta rays, sea turtles, and vibrant coral gardens. Join a guided morning snorkel tour with equipment provided, offering calm, crystal-clear waters ideal for underwater exploration.

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience
experiences.description: Indulge in an extraordinary fine-dining experience at an iconic underwater restaurant surrounded by panoramic views of the coral reef and marine life. Savor a curated tasting menu featuring fresh Maldivian seafood and international cuisine while fish glide past your table — the ultimate luxury honeymoon dinner.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk
experiences.description: Witness the magical natural phenomenon of bioluminescent plankton lighting up the shoreline in electric blue as waves wash ashore after dark. Walk hand-in-hand along a secluded beach, wade in the glowing surf, and stargaze under one of the world's darkest, most star-filled skies — a truly unforgettable romantic moment.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Visit the historic capital island of Malé and a traditional fishing village to discover Maldivian heritage, local mosques, and artisan crafts. Follow up with a hands-on cooking class learning to prepare authentic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and freshly baked roshi flatbread with a local family.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk
experiences.description: Witness the magical natural phenomenon of bioluminescent plankton lighting up the shoreline in electric blue as waves wash ashore after dark. Walk hand-in-hand along a secluded beach, wade in the glowing surf, and stargaze under one of the world's darkest, most star-filled skies — a truly unforgettable romantic moment.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Malé International Airport at 13:00. Clear immigration and customs, then arrange a speedboat or local ferry transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, freshen up, and explore the resort grounds and beachfront. Take a relaxing stroll along the beach and get oriented with the resort facilities.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the stunning Indian Ocean sunset from the beachfront. Head to the resort's casual beach bar for a welcome drink. Enjoy a light dinner at the resort's budget-friendly dining option to recover from travel fatigue.

meals.breakfast: Meal on the flight
meals.lunch: Grab a quick bite at Malé Airport — local short eats like samosas and fish rolls at the airport café (approx. $5–8)
meals.dinner: Resort's casual beachside restaurant — opt for the set menu or local Maldivian fish curry with rice (approx. $15–20)

day_by_day.notes: Day 1 is intentionally light due to arrival at 13:00. Confirm speedboat/ferry transfer costs in advance — local ferries are significantly cheaper than private speedboats ($3–10 vs $80–150). Keep receipts for budget tracking.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling session directly from the resort's house reef. Rent snorkel gear from the resort (or bring your own to save costs). Explore vibrant coral gardens, spot reef fish, sea turtles, and colorful marine life. The house reef is free to access and offers world-class snorkeling.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a budget group snorkeling excursion to a nearby snorkeling hotspot or sandbank. Group tours are far cheaper than private charters. Alternatively, explore the local island on foot — visit the island's fishing harbor, local shops, and interact with friendly locals.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic beachfront dinner for two under the stars. Lay out a sarong on the beach with takeaway food from a local café. Enjoy the sound of the waves and the warm tropical breeze.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet or local teashop (sai — Maldivian tea with mas huni, a coconut and tuna dish, approx. $5–8)
meals.lunch: Local island café — tuna sandwich, short eats, and fresh fruit juice (approx. $6–10)
meals.dinner: Beachside casual dining at the resort or nearby local restaurant — grilled fish with rice and salad (approx. $15–18)

day_by_day.notes: Book group snorkeling tours at the resort's activity desk — group rates can be as low as $20–30 per person. Bring reef-safe sunscreen to protect the coral ecosystem.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga or meditation session on the beach at sunrise — many resorts offer complimentary or low-cost yoga sessions. Follow with a refreshing swim in the crystal-clear lagoon. The calm morning waters are perfect for floating and relaxing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore a nearby uninhabited sandbank by joining a budget group excursion. Sandbank picnics are a quintessential Maldivian experience — bring your own snacks and drinks to save costs. Snorkel around the sandbank and look for reef sharks and manta rays.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk — witness the magical natural phenomenon of bioluminescent plankton lighting up the shoreline. Walk along the beach after dark and watch the waves glow electric blue with every splash. A truly romantic and unforgettable experience.

meals.breakfast: Mas huni with roshi (flatbread) and Maldivian tea at a local teashop (approx. $4–6)
meals.lunch: Pack a DIY picnic for the sandbank — buy fresh fruits, local snacks, and water from the island's small grocery shop (approx. $8–12)
meals.dinner: Resort restaurant — fresh catch of the day grilled with local spices and coconut rice (approx. $16–20)

day_by_day.notes: The Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk is best experienced on a new moon night when the sky is darkest. Check the lunar calendar and confirm the phenomenon is active with resort staff. Wear dark clothing and avoid using phone flashlights to enhance the experience.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning dolphin watching cruise — join a budget group boat tour at sunrise when dolphins are most active. Spinner dolphins are commonly spotted in the Maldives and love to bow-ride boats. A magical and romantic experience for couples.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend the afternoon at the beach. Practice stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) or kayaking in the calm lagoon — many resorts offer complimentary use of non-motorized water sports equipment. Explore the lagoon at your own pace.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic sunset cruise on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat. Budget group sunset cruises are available from most resorts and local operators for $25–40 per person. Enjoy the golden hour over the Indian Ocean with your partner.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the dolphin cruise — banana, local pastry, and tea from the resort café (approx. $5–7)
meals.lunch: Local island restaurant — garudhiya (Maldivian fish broth soup) with rice and lime (approx. $8–12)
meals.dinner: Beachfront barbecue night at the resort — grilled seafood platter with salad and local bread (approx. $18–22)

day_by_day.notes: Book dolphin watching and sunset cruise together with the same operator for a potential combo discount. Bring a light jacket for the evening cruise as it can get breezy on the water.

day_by_day.morning: Snorkeling at a famous nearby coral reef or dive site accessible by group tour. Look for blacktip reef sharks, eagle rays, and dense schools of tropical fish. Many budget snorkeling tours include multiple reef stops in one trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Malé, the capital city, via local ferry for a cultural half-day excursion. Explore the colorful Malé Fish Market, the Old Friday Mosque (Hukuru Miskiy), and the vibrant local streets. Shop for affordable Maldivian souvenirs and handicrafts.
day_by_day.evening: Dine in Malé at a local restaurant for an authentic and budget-friendly Maldivian meal before taking the evening ferry back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — egg dish with toast and fresh tropical fruit juice (approx. $8–10)
meals.lunch: Local restaurant in Malé — hedhikaa (Maldivian short eats platter) with tea (approx. $5–8)
meals.dinner: Malé local restaurant — tuna curry, rice, and papadum before the ferry back (approx. $10–15)

day_by_day.notes: Local ferries to Malé are very affordable ($1–3 each way). Check the ferry schedule in advance and plan to return on the last evening ferry. The fish market is most lively in the early morning and late afternoon.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely morning — sleep in and enjoy a slow breakfast. Take a long romantic walk along the full length of the island's beach. Collect shells, dip your feet in the warm lagoon, and enjoy the peaceful morning atmosphere.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkeling session at the resort's house reef focusing on underwater photography. If you have a waterproof camera or phone case, this is the perfect time to capture the vibrant marine life. Look for nudibranchs, sea turtles, and moray eels in the coral crevices.
day_by_day.evening: DIY romantic beach picnic dinner. Purchase fresh ingredients from the local island shop — fruits, cheese, crackers, local snacks, and drinks. Set up on the beach with candles (battery-powered tea lights) for a private romantic dinner at a fraction of the cost of a resort setup.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast buffet — treat yourselves to the full spread (approx. $12–15 per person)
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort beach bar — fresh coconut, fruit platter, and a light sandwich (approx. $10–14)
meals.dinner: DIY beach picnic — local shop groceries including fruits, snacks, and drinks (approx. $15–20 total for two)

day_by_day.notes: This is a designated rest and romance day. Use this day to recharge and enjoy simple pleasures. The DIY picnic dinner is a great budget hack that also creates a uniquely intimate experience.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget group snorkeling tour to a manta ray cleaning station if available in the area. Mantas are frequently spotted in the Maldives and watching them glide through the water is a breathtaking experience. Alternatively, explore a new section of the house reef.
day_by_day.afternoon: Attend a free or low-cost resort activity — many resorts offer complimentary cultural demonstrations such as traditional Maldivian cooking classes, bodu beru drumming performances, or local craft making. Check the resort's activity board.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk (second visit if conditions are ideal). The phenomenon varies in intensity, and a second visit may offer an even more spectacular display. Walk hand-in-hand along the glowing shoreline for a deeply romantic experience.

meals.breakfast: Local teashop breakfast — roshi with coconut sambal and Maldivian tea (approx. $4–6)
meals.lunch: Resort casual dining — tuna salad wrap and fresh lime soda (approx. $10–13)
meals.dinner: Resort set dinner menu — three-course meal at the most affordable dining venue on the resort (approx. $20–25 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Midway point of the trip — review your budget spending so far and adjust accordingly for the remaining days. Check if the resort offers any mid-stay loyalty discounts or free activity vouchers.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning fishing excursion — join a traditional Maldivian hand-line fishing trip on a local dhoni boat. This is a fun, authentic, and affordable activity ($20–35 per person for group tours). Fish caught can sometimes be cooked for you at the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax at the resort's pool or beach after the morning activity. Enjoy the warm afternoon sun, read a book, or simply float in the lagoon. This is your free time to enjoy the resort amenities you're paying for.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange for the fish caught in the morning to be grilled by the resort kitchen (small preparation fee may apply) for a unique and memorable private dinner experience. Enjoy your own catch on the beach.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-fishing breakfast — banana, granola bar, and tea (approx. $4–6)
meals.lunch: Post-fishing lunch at local café — fresh fish sandwich and coconut water (approx. $8–11)
meals.dinner: Your own catch grilled by the resort kitchen — a unique and romantic dining experience (approx. $10–15 preparation fee + fresh fish)

day_by_day.notes: Confirm with the resort in advance whether they allow guests to bring in self-caught fish for preparation. Most resorts accommodate this with a small fee. This creates a memorable and budget-friendly romantic dinner.

day_by_day.morning: Explore a neighboring local island by taking a short local ferry ride. Visit the island's school, mosque, and community areas to understand authentic Maldivian village life. Interact with locals and learn about traditional island culture.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkeling at the neighboring island's reef — local islands often have excellent and uncrowded snorkeling spots. Bring your own gear to avoid rental costs. Look for sea turtles, which are commonly found resting near local island reefs.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon ferry. Enjoy a quiet evening watching the stars from the beach. The Maldives has minimal light pollution, making it an exceptional stargazing destination. Download a free star map app to identify constellations.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — fresh tropical fruit bowl with yogurt and granola (approx. $8–10)
meals.lunch: Local island teashop — authentic Maldivian lunch of rice, fish curry, and papadum (approx. $5–8)
meals.dinner: Resort casual restaurant — pasta or pizza option for a lighter budget-friendly dinner (approx. $13–17)

day_by_day.notes: Visiting local islands is one of the best ways to experience authentic Maldivian culture on a budget. Dress modestly when visiting local islands — cover shoulders and knees out of respect for local customs.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise snorkeling session — the early morning light filtering through the water creates magical visibility and colors. The reef is quietest at dawn with the most active marine life. Set an alarm and head straight to the house reef at first light.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon learning about Maldivian marine conservation. Many resorts offer free or low-cost reef monitoring walks and marine biology talks. Participate in a coral planting activity if available — a meaningful and unique honeymoon experience.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic evening walk along the full beach perimeter at dusk. Collect memories, take photos, and enjoy the last golden light of the day. Have dinner at the resort while reminiscing about the trip's highlights so far.

meals.breakfast: Pre-snorkeling light snack — energy bar and water, then proper breakfast after returning (approx. $8–12 for full breakfast)
meals.lunch: Beach bar lunch — fresh coconut, grilled corn, and a local fish roll (approx. $9–12)
meals.dinner: Resort restaurant — Maldivian fish curry with coconut rice and fresh salad (approx. $16–20)

day_by_day.notes: Coral planting activities are increasingly offered by eco-conscious resorts and are a wonderful way to give back to the ocean that has given you so much joy during the trip. Ask the resort's dive/marine team for details.

day_by_day.morning: Final major snorkeling excursion — book one last group snorkeling tour to the best reef site in the area. Make it count by going early when visibility is at its peak. Try to spot anything you haven't seen yet — whale sharks, hammerheads, or large schools of barracuda.
day_by_day.afternoon: Souvenir shopping at the local island market and resort gift shop. Look for affordable Maldivian lacquerwork (laajehun), hand-woven mats, and local spices. Compare prices between the local island and resort shop — local markets are always cheaper.
day_by_day.evening: Special romantic dinner to celebrate the near-end of the honeymoon trip. Choose the resort's best dining venue and order a slightly more indulgent meal. This is your one splurge evening — enjoy it fully.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast buffet — enjoy every item on offer (approx. $12–15 per person)
meals.lunch: Local island café — light lunch of short eats and fresh juice (approx. $7–10)
meals.dinner: Resort's signature restaurant — splurge on a romantic set dinner with fresh lobster or premium fish (approx. $35–50 per person as a planned splurge)

day_by_day.notes: Budget approximately $70–100 for this evening's dinner as a planned romantic splurge. It's the second-to-last full day, and a special dinner here is a meaningful investment in the honeymoon experience.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning snorkel or swim in the house reef — say goodbye to the marine life you've come to know over the past 12 days. Take a slow, meditative swim and soak in every last moment of the crystal-clear Maldivian waters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pack and prepare for departure. Do a final walk around the entire resort and beach to collect last memories. Take photos of your favorite spots. Visit the resort's activity desk to leave feedback and ask about any loyalty program benefits for future stays.
day_by_day.evening: Final sunset viewing from the beach — sit together and watch the sun dip below the Indian Ocean horizon one last time. Reflect on the incredible experiences of the past 12 days. Enjoy a final casual dinner at the resort.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — make it a full and satisfying meal to start the final full day right (approx. $10–14)
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the beach bar — fresh fruit smoothie, sandwich, and coconut water (approx. $10–13)
meals.dinner: Final dinner at the resort's casual beachside restaurant — grilled fish, salad, and a celebratory mocktail toast (approx. $20–25)

day_by_day.notes: Confirm departure transfer arrangements (speedboat/ferry to Malé airport) for the following day. Settle any outstanding resort bills. Pack snorkel gear and any wet items in plastic bags to protect luggage.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning final swim or beach walk before checkout. Enjoy a last breakfast at the resort. Check out and arrange transfer to Malé International Airport. Allow plenty of time for the boat transfer and airport check-in procedures.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Malé airport for departure. Browse the duty-free shops for last-minute gifts — Maldivian vanilla, local honey, and small handicrafts make great budget-friendly souvenirs. Reflect on the magical 13-day honeymoon adventure.
day_by_day.evening: Departure flight. Carry the memories of bioluminescent beaches, vibrant coral reefs, romantic sunsets, and the warm turquoise waters of the Maldives back home.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — enjoy the full buffet one last time (approx. $10–14)
meals.lunch: Airport café in Malé — local short eats and tea for a final taste of Maldivian flavors (approx. $6–10)
meals.dinner: In-flight meal

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3–4 hours before your flight for the boat transfer to Malé and airport check-in. Maldives airport security can be slow during peak periods. Keep all important documents — passport, boarding pass, insurance — easily accessible in your carry-on bag.

trip_options.title: Classic Maldives Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

Walk hand-in-hand along a secluded beach, wade in the glowing surf, and stargaze under one of the world's darkest, most star-filled skies — a truly unforgettable romantic moment.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 13:00. Complete immigration and customs, then meet your resort transfer representative. Board a speedboat or seaplane transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in to your Beachfront accommodation, freshen up, and take a leisurely orientation walk along the beach to get acquainted with the resort grounds and facilities.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic welcome sunset from your beachfront villa or the resort's main jetty. Head to the resort's main restaurant for a relaxed welcome dinner — opt for the à la carte menu featuring fresh Maldivian seafood and Indian Ocean-inspired dishes.

meals.breakfast: Enjoy a meal on the plane or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: Light snack or meal at Velana International Airport before or after arrival
meals.dinner: Welcome dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort's main restaurant — try the grilled reef fish with coconut rice and a tropical mocktail or house wine (mid-range set menu ~$40–60 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Request a welcome amenity or honeymoon setup from the resort in advance — many resorts offer complimentary flower arrangements, fruit baskets, or sparkling wine for honeymooners. Keep the evening light as jet lag may set in.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early and enjoy your first full Maldivian sunrise from your beachfront villa. After a leisurely breakfast, head to the resort's house reef for a guided snorkeling orientation session. Explore the vibrant coral gardens just steps from your beach, spotting parrotfish, angelfish, and sea turtles in the crystal-clear lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a relaxed lunch. Spend the afternoon unwinding on your private stretch of beach — rent a paddleboard or kayak from the resort's water sports center for a gentle exploration of the lagoon. Alternatively, book a couples' spa treatment at the resort's overwater spa for a 60-minute traditional Maldivian massage.
day_by_day.evening: Book the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne experience. Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditionally decorated Maldivian dhoni boat, sipping champagne as the sun dips below the horizon. A perfect romantic evening for honeymooners.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's main restaurant — enjoy tropical fruits, fresh pastries, eggs made to order, and Maldivian roshi bread with tuna curry
meals.lunch: Casual beachside grill at the resort's beach bar — grilled chicken wrap, fresh salad, and a coconut water (~$20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: Light dinner back at the resort after the dhoni cruise — the resort's à la carte restaurant offers a seafood platter and pasta options (~$35–50 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Book the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise at least 24 hours in advance through the resort's activities desk. Bring sunscreen, a light wrap, and your camera for golden hour photography.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a guided snorkeling excursion to Maaya Thila Marine Reserve — one of the Maldives' most celebrated snorkeling and diving sites. Encounter reef sharks, Napoleon wrasse, giant moray eels, and schools of colorful reef fish in this UNESCO-recognized marine sanctuary. The morning light makes for the best underwater visibility.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by early afternoon. Enjoy a leisurely lunch and then spend the afternoon relaxing in your beachfront villa's private outdoor space. Take a nap in your hammock or lounge by the resort's infinity pool overlooking the lagoon. Alternatively, join a resort-organized glass-bottom boat tour to explore the reef without getting wet.
day_by_day.evening: Dine at the resort's specialty seafood restaurant for a romantic candlelit dinner. Order the catch of the day prepared in your choice of style — grilled, pan-seared, or in a traditional Maldivian curry with coconut milk and pandan leaf.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at the resort before the morning excursion — grab fresh fruit, yogurt, and coffee from the breakfast buffet
meals.lunch: Post-snorkeling lunch at the resort's poolside restaurant — fish and chips, tropical fruit smoothie, and a shared dessert (~$25–35 per person)
meals.dinner: Specialty seafood dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort's fine-dining outlet — 3-course meal with wine pairing (~$55–80 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The Maaya Thila excursion typically departs early morning (7:00–8:00 AM). Confirm departure times and bring anti-nausea medication if prone to seasickness. Reef-safe sunscreen is mandatory at marine reserves.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow, romantic morning — order in-villa breakfast delivered to your beachfront terrace and watch the lagoon come alive with morning light. After breakfast, take a long leisurely walk along the resort's sandbank, collecting shells and enjoying the solitude of the early morning beach.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join the Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class excursion. Visit the historic capital island of Malé and a traditional fishing village to discover Maldivian heritage, handicrafts, and local life. Participate in a hands-on cooking class learning to prepare traditional dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut salad), garudhiya fish soup, and sweet bondi.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort in the early evening. Freshen up and enjoy the dishes you prepared during the cooking class as part of the experience, or dine at the resort's casual beachfront bar with live acoustic music — a relaxed, romantic end to a culturally rich day.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast delivered to your beachfront terrace — a romantic experience with tropical fruits, pastries, eggs, and fresh juices (complimentary or ~$15–20 extra per person)
meals.lunch: Traditional Maldivian lunch tasted during the cultural village tour and cooking class — included in the experience
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort's beachfront bar — grilled skewers, mezze-style sharing plates, and tropical cocktails (~$30–45 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The cultural village tour typically takes 4–6 hours. Dress modestly when visiting Malé — cover shoulders and knees out of respect for local customs. Bring local currency (Maldivian Rufiyaa) or USD for small purchases at local markets.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the day with a sunrise yoga session on the beach — check if the resort offers complimentary or low-cost morning yoga classes. After yoga, enjoy breakfast and then head out for a self-guided snorkeling session at the resort's house reef, exploring areas you may have missed on Day 2.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the resort's overwater spa. Indulge in a couples' signature treatment — a 90-minute Maldivian Journey ritual incorporating coconut oil, volcanic sand exfoliation, and warm stone therapy. Afterward, relax on the spa's overwater deck and soak in the panoramic ocean views.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the magical Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk. After dark, take a guided walk along the shoreline to witness the stunning natural phenomenon of bioluminescent plankton lighting up the beach in electric blue hues — a truly unforgettable and romantic experience.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the main restaurant — fuel up before yoga and snorkeling with a hearty spread
meals.lunch: Light spa lunch — order a healthy salad, fresh juice, and a light wrap from the resort's spa menu or poolside café (~$20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: Early dinner at the resort's main restaurant before the bioluminescent walk — choose from the daily specials board, typically featuring fresh catch and vegetarian options (~$35–50 per person)

day_by_day.notes: The Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk is best experienced on a new moon night when the sky is darkest. Confirm with the resort's activities team whether conditions are optimal. Avoid using phone flashlights during the walk to preserve the natural effect.

day_by_day.morning: Take a morning speedboat excursion to a nearby uninhabited sandbank for a private picnic breakfast on a deserted island. Many resorts in the Maldives offer this romantic add-on — coordinate with the resort's activities desk. Snorkel the surrounding reef and enjoy complete privacy on your own slice of paradise.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by midday. Spend the afternoon at leisure — lounge by the infinity pool, browse the resort's boutique for local crafts and souvenirs, or simply relax in your beachfront villa with a good book and the sound of the ocean.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise or opt for a romantic in-villa dining experience — have the resort set up a private candlelit dinner on your beachfront terrace with a curated menu of your favorite dishes from the week.

meals.breakfast: Private sandbank picnic breakfast arranged by the resort — tropical fruits, pastries, fresh juices, and coffee delivered to your deserted island (~$30–50 per person add-on)
meals.lunch: Casual poolside lunch at the resort — burger, salad, and fresh lemonade (~$20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: Romantic private beachfront dinner at your villa — pre-arranged with the resort, 3-course set menu with wine (~$70–100 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Private sandbank excursions and in-villa dining should be booked at least 48 hours in advance. This is an ideal evening for a special honeymoon milestone — consider arranging a surprise flower arrangement or personalized dessert.

day_by_day.morning: Midpoint of the trip — enjoy a slow, unplanned morning. Sleep in, order room service, and spend the morning simply being present in your beautiful surroundings. Take a morning swim in the lagoon and enjoy the quiet before the resort's other guests wake up.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join an afternoon dolphin watching excursion — a popular activity in the Maldives, particularly in Ari Atoll and surrounding areas. Speedboats follow pods of spinner dolphins as they leap and play in the wake, a joyful and memorable experience. Return to the resort by late afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Dine at the Underwater Restaurant for a truly extraordinary fine-dining experience. Surrounded by a panoramic aquarium of Indian Ocean marine life — rays, sharks, and tropical fish gliding past your table — enjoy a multi-course tasting menu in one of the world's most iconic dining settings.

meals.breakfast: In-room service breakfast — a lazy morning treat with continental spread, fresh juices, and coffee
meals.lunch: Light snack at the resort's beach bar before the dolphin excursion — fruit platter, sandwiches, and iced tea (~$15–25 per person)
meals.dinner: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience — multi-course tasting menu (~$100–150 per person, book well in advance as this is a highly sought-after experience)

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Restaurant is an exceptional splurge for honeymooners — book as early as possible as tables are extremely limited. Dress code is typically smart casual. This is the trip's highlight dining experience and well worth the mid-range budget stretch.

day_by_day.morning: Join a guided morning snorkeling trip to a different reef site near the resort — ask the activities desk about nearby coral gardens, turtle cleaning stations, or manta ray feeding areas depending on the season. Morning snorkeling offers the best light and marine activity.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for lunch and a relaxing afternoon. Try a water sport you haven't yet attempted — windsurfing, jet skiing, or a parasailing session over the lagoon for a bird's-eye view of the resort and surrounding turquoise waters.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a casual, relaxed evening at the resort's beachfront bar. Order cocktails and watch the stars emerge over the Indian Ocean — the Maldives' remote location means minimal light pollution and spectacular stargazing. Ask the resort if they offer a telescope or stargazing program.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the main restaurant — stock up before the morning snorkeling trip
meals.lunch: Beachside lunch at the resort — fresh tuna salad, grilled corn, and a tropical smoothie bowl (~$20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort's beachfront bar — sharing platters of calamari, spring rolls, and grilled prawns with cocktails (~$30–45 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Check with the resort about seasonal marine sightings — March is generally an excellent month for manta rays in the Maldives. The evening stargazing experience is best after 9:00 PM when the sky is fully dark.

day_by_day.morning: Take a morning excursion to a local inhabited island — a great way to experience authentic Maldivian life beyond the resort. Explore the island's narrow streets, visit the local mosque, browse small shops selling handmade lacquerware and woven mats, and chat with friendly locals.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a leisurely afternoon. Treat yourselves to a second spa session — try individual treatments this time, such as a deep tissue massage for one and a rejuvenating facial for the other. Meet afterward for afternoon tea on the spa deck.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic dinner at the resort's main fine-dining restaurant. By now you'll be familiar with the menu — ask the chef for their personal recommendation or request a special off-menu preparation if you have a favorite dish.

meals.breakfast: Early buffet breakfast before the local island excursion
meals.lunch: Try a local 'short eat' snack at a tea shop on the inhabited island — hedhikaa (savory fish pastries) and black tea for an authentic Maldivian experience (~$5–10 per person)
meals.dinner: Fine-dining dinner at the resort's signature restaurant — 3-course meal with a bottle of wine or mocktails (~$60–80 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly when visiting inhabited islands — swimwear and revealing clothing are not appropriate outside of designated areas. Bring small USD bills for local purchases and tips. This excursion offers a meaningful cultural contrast to the luxury resort experience.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate the morning to a longer, more adventurous snorkeling session — join the resort's snorkeling guide for a 2-hour deep water reef exploration targeting larger marine life such as whale sharks (seasonal), eagle rays, and barracuda schools. This is a step up from the house reef experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and enjoy a long, indulgent lunch. Spend the rest of the afternoon doing absolutely nothing — lie in the hammock, float in the lagoon, read, nap, and simply savor the beauty of your surroundings. A true mid-trip reset.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a private bonfire on the beach through the resort — many Maldivian resorts offer this romantic add-on. Sit by the fire with drinks, listen to the waves, and watch shooting stars overhead. A simple but deeply romantic evening.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before the snorkeling excursion — yogurt, granola, fruit, and coffee
meals.lunch: Long, leisurely lunch at the resort's main restaurant — order generously and take your time, sharing a seafood pasta, a fresh salad, and a dessert (~$35–50 per person)
meals.dinner: Casual in-room dining or beachside snacks by the bonfire — order a sharing board of cheeses, charcuterie, and tropical fruits with wine or cocktails (~$30–40 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Private beach bonfires should be arranged 24 hours in advance. Some resorts include this as part of honeymoon packages — check if it's already included in your booking. Bring a light blanket as ocean breezes can feel cooler after sunset.

day_by_day.morning: Revisit your favorite activity of the trip — whether that's snorkeling the house reef, paddleboarding at sunrise, or simply enjoying a slow breakfast on your terrace. Use this morning to do whatever brought you the most joy during the past 10 days.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a final afternoon excursion — a sunset fishing trip on a traditional Maldivian dhoni. Try your hand at traditional hand-line fishing with local fishermen, and if you're lucky, the resort's kitchen will prepare your catch for dinner. A fun, authentic, and memorable experience.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a special penultimate evening dinner — return to the Underwater Restaurant if you loved it, or request the resort arrange a romantic overwater dining setup on the jetty with lanterns, flowers, and a personalized menu.

meals.breakfast: Your favorite breakfast of the trip — whether buffet, in-villa, or beachside, make it special
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch at the resort — light and fresh, saving appetite for the special evening dinner
meals.dinner: Special overwater jetty dinner or repeat Underwater Restaurant visit — 3 to 4-course meal (~$70–120 per person depending on venue)

day_by_day.notes: This is a great evening to exchange heartfelt honeymoon gifts or letters if you've planned any. Coordinate with the resort's romance team to add personal touches like a custom cake, monogrammed menus, or a photographer for the evening.

day_by_day.morning: Final full morning in the Maldives — wake up early for one last sunrise swim in the lagoon. Take a long, slow walk along the entire stretch of the resort's beach, pausing to take photographs and absorb every detail of the paradise you've called home for nearly two weeks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of the resort and complete any last-minute souvenir shopping at the resort boutique or local island market. Pack your bags thoughtfully — Maldivian coral and shells cannot be taken out of the country. Spend the remaining resort time by the pool or beach until your transfer.
day_by_day.evening: If your departure flight allows, enjoy a final casual dinner at the resort or at the airport. Reflect on the incredible memories made during your honeymoon in the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Final buffet breakfast at the resort — enjoy every dish you loved over the past 12 days
meals.lunch: Light farewell lunch at the resort's beach bar — keep it simple and fresh (~$20–30 per person)
meals.dinner: Dinner at Velana International Airport or on the flight — airport options include local Maldivian dishes and international cuisine at the departure terminal

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your resort transfer time the evening before checkout. Seaplane transfers must be completed before sunset, so coordinate carefully with the resort. Keep important documents — passports, flight tickets, insurance — easily accessible in your carry-on.

day_by_day.morning: Departure day — if your flight departs in the morning or early afternoon, enjoy a final coffee or tea at the airport lounge. Browse duty-free for last-minute Maldivian gifts such as local honey, vanilla, or handmade lacquerware. Board your Lufthansa flight home, carrying with you memories of an extraordinary honeymoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: In-flight — relax, watch movies, and reminisce about your Maldives adventure. Begin planning your next trip together.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive home — unpack, rest, and start organizing your honeymoon photographs. Consider creating a photo album or journal as a lasting keepsake of your time in the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Airport café breakfast at Velana International Airport — coffee, pastry, or a full English breakfast at one of the terminal restaurants
meals.lunch: In-flight meal provided by Lufthansa
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or dinner at home upon arrival

day_by_day.notes: Maldives departure tax is typically included in your flight ticket, but confirm this when checking in. Arrive at the airport at least 2.5–3 hours before international departure. Consider upgrading to premium economy or business class for the return flight as a final honeymoon luxury.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for two. Enjoy chilled champagne, fresh tropical fruit platters, and breathtaking 360-degree sunset views over the atolls. A quintessential romantic experience perfect for honeymooners.

experiences.name: Snorkeling at Maaya Thila Marine Reserve
experiences.description: Explore one of the Maldives' most celebrated snorkeling and diving sites, teeming with reef sharks, manta rays, sea turtles, and vibrant coral gardens. Join a guided morning snorkel tour with equipment provided, offering calm, crystal-clear waters ideal for underwater exploration.

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience
experiences.description: Indulge in an extraordinary fine-dining experience at an iconic underwater restaurant surrounded by panoramic views of the coral reef and marine life. Savor a curated tasting menu featuring fresh Maldivian seafood and international cuisine while fish glide past your table — the ultimate luxury honeymoon dinner.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk
experiences.description: Witness the magical natural phenomenon of bioluminescent plankton lighting up the shoreline in electric blue as waves wash ashore after dark. Walk hand-in-hand along a secluded beach, wade in the glowing surf, and stargaze under one of the world's darkest, most star-filled skies — a truly unforgettable romantic moment.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Visit the historic capital island of Malé and a traditional fishing village to discover Maldivian heritage, local mosques, and artisan crafts. Follow up with a hands-on cooking class learning to prepare authentic dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and freshly baked roshi flatbread with a local family.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrival at Velana International Airport, Malé at 13:00. Meet your dedicated resort butler at the arrivals hall for a seamless VIP transfer. Board your private luxury speedboat to Aegean Bliss Resort. Upon arrival, enjoy a traditional Maldivian welcome with fresh coconut water and flower garlands. Private resort orientation tour with your personal butler, followed by champagne check-in on your beachfront villa terrace overlooking the lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into your Beachfront Villa — unpack, freshen up, and enjoy the stunning sunset from your private deck. Light welcome dinner arranged by the resort as part of your arrival experience, featuring a curated selection of Maldivian-inspired canapés and chilled rosé.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (in-flight)
meals.lunch: Light refreshments and welcome bites provided by resort upon arrival
meals.dinner: Private welcome dinner on your beachfront villa deck — curated by the resort chef featuring fresh seafood, tropical fruits, and a bottle of premium champagne under the stars

day_by_day.notes: Ensure all snorkeling gear preferences and dietary requirements are communicated to your butler upon arrival. Request a pillow menu and in-villa amenity preferences for the duration of your stay. Time zone adjustment tip: Maldives is UTC+5.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely breakfast on your private villa deck as the sun rises over the Indian Ocean. After breakfast, enjoy a guided house reef snorkeling session directly from your beachfront villa — your personal snorkeling guide will introduce you to the vibrant coral gardens, reef fish, and sea turtles that inhabit the resort's protected lagoon. Equipment provided and fully fitted by the dive center.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in a couples' spa journey at the resort's overwater spa pavilion — begin with a traditional Maldivian coconut scrub followed by a 90-minute four-hands massage using locally sourced volcanic oils and jasmine extracts. Post-spa, lounge by the infinity pool with crafted tropical cocktails and a private cabana service.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for just the two of you. Watch the sky turn gold and crimson as you sip vintage Moët & Chandon and enjoy a curated charcuterie and fresh fruit platter prepared by the resort chef.

meals.breakfast: Gourmet à la carte breakfast on villa deck — fresh tropical fruits, eggs Benedict with smoked marlin, freshly baked pastries, and cold-pressed juices
meals.lunch: Beachside grill lunch at the resort's Aqua Terrace Restaurant — grilled lobster, prawn skewers, and a chilled cucumber gazpacho
meals.dinner: Return from sunset cruise to a candlelit dinner at the resort's signature fine-dining restaurant — five-course tasting menu with wine pairing featuring pan-seared sea bass, truffle risotto, and a dark chocolate fondant

day_by_day.notes: Book the Sunset Dhoni Cruise at least 24 hours in advance through your butler. Best snorkeling visibility on the house reef is typically between 07:00–10:00. Apply reef-safe sunscreen only.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning yoga session on the overwater yoga pavilion at sunrise — a private instructor guides you through a restorative flow as the ocean shimmers beneath you. Followed by a nourishing wellness breakfast at the spa café featuring smoothie bowls, chia pudding, and herbal teas.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkeling at Maaya Thila Marine Reserve — one of the Maldives' most celebrated snorkeling and diving sites, teeming with reef sharks, manta rays, napoleon wrasse, and thousands of reef fish. A resort marine biologist accompanies you on a private guided snorkeling excursion by speedboat. Spend approximately two hours exploring this UNESCO-recognized marine sanctuary.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a golden hour swim in your private villa plunge pool. As darkness falls, experience the magical Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk — witness bioluminescent plankton illuminating the shoreline in electric blue light as waves wash ashore. A romantic, otherworldly experience guided by the resort's naturalist.

meals.breakfast: Wellness breakfast at the overwater spa café — acai bowls, fresh tropical fruit platters, green smoothies, and gluten-free granola with coconut yogurt
meals.lunch: Packed gourmet picnic lunch enjoyed on the boat during the Maaya Thila excursion — lobster rolls, fresh salads, tropical juices, and artisan chocolates
meals.dinner: Romantic dinner for two at the resort's beach-edge restaurant — fresh catch of the day prepared tableside, paired with a curated selection from the sommelier's reserve wine list

day_by_day.notes: Maaya Thila excursion requires a 30-minute speedboat transfer — confirm departure time with butler the evening before. Bioluminescence is most vivid on moonless nights; check lunar calendar with resort naturalist. Bring insect repellent for the beach walk.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a luxurious in-villa breakfast served by your butler — fresh-squeezed juices, eggs cooked to order, smoked salmon, and warm croissants delivered to your deck. Spend the morning at leisure on your private stretch of beach — read, swim in the crystal-clear lagoon, or simply soak in the paradise surroundings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class — visit the historic capital island of Malé and a traditional fishing village to discover Maldivian heritage, architecture, and daily life. Explore the Grand Friday Mosque, the bustling fish market, and artisan workshops. Then join a hands-on cooking class led by a local chef, learning to prepare traditional Maldivian dishes including mas huni (tuna and coconut salad), garudhiya (fish broth), and bondibai (rice pudding).
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort refreshed and culturally enriched. Enjoy sundowner cocktails at the resort's overwater bar — try the signature 'Maldivian Drift' cocktail featuring local arrack, passion fruit, and fresh lime. Dinner at the resort's premium restaurant with the dishes you learned to cook serving as inspiration for the evening's menu.

meals.breakfast: Lavish in-villa breakfast served on the beachfront deck — full tropical spread with personalized egg station, freshly baked bread, premium cold cuts, and exotic fruit selection
meals.lunch: Traditional Maldivian lunch as part of the cooking class experience — enjoy the dishes you prepared with your local hosts in an authentic village setting
meals.dinner: Overwater fine-dining restaurant — Maldivian-inspired contemporary cuisine with a modern twist, featuring tuna tataki, coconut-poached snapper, and a passionfruit panna cotta

day_by_day.notes: Cultural tour requires a speedboat transfer to Malé (approximately 20–30 minutes). Dress modestly when visiting the mosque — shoulders and knees should be covered. Photography is welcome in most areas but ask permission before photographing locals.

day_by_day.morning: Private sunrise kayaking session through the resort's lagoon and mangrove channels — your guide points out juvenile reef sharks, eagle rays, and exotic bird species. A serene and intimate way to explore the island's natural ecosystem. Return for a leisurely breakfast on the villa deck.
day_by_day.afternoon: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience — indulge in an extraordinary fine-dining lunch at the resort's iconic underwater restaurant. Surrounded by panoramic floor-to-ceiling acrylic panels, dine as reef sharks, rays, and schools of tropical fish glide gracefully past your table. The multi-course menu showcases premium seafood with global influences, paired with a curated wine selection.
day_by_day.evening: Couples' sunset cocktail hour on your private villa deck with a personalized charcuterie board prepared by the resort chef. As evening sets in, enjoy a private stargazing experience on the beach — the resort's astronomer sets up a high-powered telescope and guides you through the southern hemisphere constellations above the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Post-kayaking breakfast on villa deck — avocado toast with poached eggs, smoked fish platter, fresh tropical juices, and a selection of herbal teas and premium coffees
meals.lunch: Underwater Restaurant multi-course fine-dining experience — amuse-bouche, seared scallops, butter-poached lobster main, artisan cheese selection, and a chocolate sphere dessert with wine pairing
meals.dinner: Light, elegant dinner at the resort's beach bar and grill — freshly caught fish tacos, grilled octopus, and a selection of premium small plates with craft cocktails

day_by_day.notes: Underwater Restaurant reservations are highly coveted — book at least 3–4 days in advance through your butler. Smart casual dress code applies. Stargazing experience is weather dependent; the resort naturalist will advise on optimal timing.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicated relaxation morning — sleep in, order a lavish in-villa breakfast, and spend the morning in your private plunge pool or on your sun loungers. Optional: book a private personal training session on the beach or a guided meditation session with the resort's wellness guru.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private sandbank picnic experience — your butler arranges a bespoke picnic on a secluded sandbank accessible only by boat. Arrive to find a beautifully styled setup with luxury sun loungers, a chilled champagne bucket, fresh seafood, and artisan sandwiches. Swim in the shallows, snorkel the surrounding reef, and enjoy total privacy in the middle of the Indian Ocean.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a sunset couples' bath ritual — your butler prepares a flower-strewn overwater bath with essential oils, rose petals, and candles. Followed by an intimate dinner at the resort's private dining pavilion — a dedicated chef's table experience with a personalized seven-course tasting menu.

meals.breakfast: Indulgent in-villa breakfast — eggs royale, fresh pastries, tropical fruit tower, freshly blended smoothies, and a mimosa to start the day
meals.lunch: Private sandbank picnic — chilled lobster, smoked salmon canapés, artisan cheese and charcuterie board, tropical fruit skewers, and a bottle of vintage Billecart-Salmon rosé champagne
meals.dinner: Private chef's table seven-course tasting menu — personalized to your preferences with wine pairings selected by the resort sommelier; courses include foie gras torchon, wagyu beef, and a deconstructed Maldivian dessert

day_by_day.notes: Sandbank availability depends on tides — confirm timing with butler the previous evening. The private dining pavilion experience should be booked 48 hours in advance and can be customized for special occasions such as anniversaries or proposals.

day_by_day.morning: Mid-trip wellness reset — begin with a 60-minute couples' hot stone massage at the overwater spa followed by a hydrotherapy circuit including steam room, cold plunge pool, and Vichy shower. Emerge refreshed and revitalized. Enjoy a healthy spa breakfast at the wellness café.
day_by_day.afternoon: Guided snorkeling expedition to a nearby coral pinnacle — your resort marine biologist leads a private two-hour snorkeling tour to explore an extraordinary coral garden teeming with lionfish, moray eels, clownfish, and hawksbill sea turtles. Learn about the resort's coral restoration program and plant your own coral fragment as a lasting contribution to the reef.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset Private Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — a second magical evening on the traditional Maldivian dhoni, this time with a live acoustic musician serenading you as you drift across the glassy ocean at dusk. Watch for dolphins playing in the bow wake as the horizon blazes with color.

meals.breakfast: Wellness spa breakfast — green smoothie bowls, overnight oats with mango compote, poached eggs on sourdough, and cold-pressed detox juices
meals.lunch: Overwater restaurant lunch — light and fresh Mediterranean-inspired menu featuring burrata, grilled sea bream, and a chilled tomato and watermelon salad
meals.dinner: Beachfront dinner under the stars at the resort's al fresco restaurant — wood-fired whole fish, grilled vegetables, and a decadent molten lava cake for dessert

day_by_day.notes: Coral planting activity is a meaningful conservation experience — ask your marine biologist for a certificate of your coral adoption. Request the acoustic musician for the dhoni cruise at least 24 hours in advance — subject to availability.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise fishing experience — join the resort's experienced Maldivian fishermen on a traditional handline fishing trip at dawn. Try your hand at the ancient art of Maldivian pole-and-line fishing in the deep blue waters surrounding the atoll. Return with your catch for the resort chef to prepare for your dinner.
day_by_day.afternoon: Leisure afternoon at the resort — enjoy the infinity pool, beach, or explore the resort's boutique for curated Maldivian crafts and luxury souvenirs. Optional: book a private mixology masterclass at the overwater bar and learn to craft three signature Maldivian-inspired cocktails with the head bartender.
day_by_day.evening: Chef's special — your morning's catch is transformed into an extraordinary personalized dinner prepared by the resort's executive chef. Dine on your beachfront villa deck with the sound of the ocean as your backdrop, accompanied by a handpicked wine from the resort's 500-label cellar.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-fishing breakfast at 05:30 — fresh fruit, yogurt, and energy bars; full breakfast served upon return featuring eggs, smoked fish, and tropical fruits
meals.lunch: Resort pool bar lunch — gourmet burgers, fresh sushi rolls, and a selection of premium salads with craft cocktails
meals.dinner: Private villa dinner featuring your morning's catch — prepared by the executive chef with a personalized four-course menu, candles, and a curated wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: Sunrise fishing departs at approximately 05:30 — confirm exact time with butler. All fish are caught sustainably; the resort only encourages catch-and-cook or catch-and-release practices. Mixology class runs for 90 minutes and includes all cocktail ingredients.

day_by_day.morning: Full morning at leisure — your most indulgent sleep-in yet. Order an extravagant in-villa breakfast for two and spend the morning alternating between your private plunge pool, the beach, and your villa's sunken day bed. Optional: arrange a private photography session with the resort's professional photographer to capture stunning couple portraits against the backdrop of the Maldivian lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Maaya Thila Marine Reserve for an afternoon snorkeling session — this time focusing on the reef's night-time residents that are visible in the shallower waters during the golden afternoon hours, including nurse sharks resting on the sandy bottom and large schools of fusiliers. Your marine guide provides an in-depth ecological briefing.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk — experience this magical phenomenon for a second time, now with a deeper understanding from your naturalist guide. Collect glowing water in your hands, trace patterns in the sand, and share this ethereal moment in complete privacy on the resort's secluded stretch of beach.

meals.breakfast: Grand in-villa breakfast feast — a full spread of continental and cooked options including smoked salmon eggs Benedict, French toast with mango coulis, a full tropical fruit tower, and premium coffee selections
meals.lunch: Beachside casual lunch — fresh coconut ceviche, grilled prawn skewers, and cold tropical juices served directly to your sun lounger
meals.dinner: Romantic candlelit dinner at the resort's overwater restaurant — seven-course degustation menu with a focus on local Maldivian ingredients elevated with French culinary technique

day_by_day.notes: Photography session should be pre-booked 48 hours in advance — the best light for portraits is during the golden hour, approximately 30 minutes before sunset. Request digital and printed copies of your images as a keepsake.

day_by_day.morning: Exclusive dolphin watching excursion — depart by private speedboat to the open ocean channels where spinner dolphins are frequently spotted in large pods during the morning hours. Your marine biologist provides fascinating commentary on dolphin behavior and Maldivian marine ecology. Snorkel alongside a resident turtle if conditions allow.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a private couples' cooking masterclass with the resort's executive chef — learn to prepare three Maldivian-inspired luxury dishes: a tuna tartare with coconut foam, a lobster bisque, and a saffron-scented rice dessert. Enjoy the fruits of your labor as a late afternoon meal.
day_by_day.evening: Sundowner cocktails at the overwater bar watching the last light fade over the Indian Ocean. Followed by the resort's weekly cultural performance evening — local musicians and traditional Bodu Beru drummers perform on the beach as guests dine al fresco under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before dolphin excursion — fresh fruit, yogurt parfait, and energy-boosting smoothies
meals.lunch: Cooking masterclass meal — enjoy the three dishes you prepared with the executive chef, accompanied by a chilled Sancerre
meals.dinner: Al fresco cultural performance dinner on the beach — Maldivian and international buffet spread with live music, featuring whole roasted fish, curried vegetables, fresh salads, and an elaborate dessert station

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin sightings are highly likely but not guaranteed — the resort has an excellent track record in known dolphin channels. The cultural performance evening occurs weekly; confirm the exact date with your butler upon arrival.

day_by_day.morning: Final spa morning — indulge in the resort's signature 'Ocean Harmony' couples' treatment: a 120-minute journey beginning with a warm coconut milk bath, followed by a full-body exfoliation using Maldivian sea salt and lime, and concluding with a deeply relaxing synchronized four-hands massage. The ultimate luxury wellness experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience — revisit this iconic dining destination for a final time, this time for an afternoon high tea experience served beneath the waves. Finger sandwiches, freshly baked scones with clotted cream, miniature pastries, and premium loose-leaf teas enjoyed as graceful manta rays drift past the glass.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset Private Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — your final sunset cruise, this time with a special arrangement by your butler: a floating floral arrangement, personalized message in a bottle, and a custom engraved champagne flute as a keepsake of your Maldivian honeymoon.

meals.breakfast: Pre-spa nourishing breakfast — warm porridge with mango compote, fresh fruit, herbal teas, and a light egg white omelette
meals.lunch: Underwater Restaurant afternoon high tea — three-tiered stand of finger sandwiches, scones with Devonshire cream and jam, miniature patisserie, and a selection of premium teas and champagne
meals.dinner: Grand farewell dinner at the resort's premier restaurant — a personalized eight-course menu created exclusively for you by the executive chef, celebrating your honeymoon with a commemorative menu card to take home

day_by_day.notes: Request the commemorative menu card and personalized message in a bottle from your butler at least 48 hours in advance. The engraved champagne flute can be arranged through the resort's concierge as a lasting memento of your honeymoon.

day_by_day.morning: Final house reef snorkeling session at dawn — one last magical swim through the coral gardens you have come to love. Take in the vibrant colors, the familiar fish, and the peaceful rhythm of the underwater world one final time. Return for a leisurely breakfast on your villa deck.
day_by_day.afternoon: Afternoon at complete leisure — pack unhurriedly, take a final dip in your private plunge pool, stroll the pristine beach collecting shells, and sip cocktails in your villa's hammock. Visit the resort boutique for any final gifts and souvenirs. Optional: a 30-minute farewell reflexology session.
day_by_day.evening: Final evening at the resort — watch the sunset from the overwater bar with your signature cocktails. Enjoy a relaxed, intimate dinner at the beach grill, keeping the evening light and unhurried as you prepare for your departure the following day.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely final full breakfast on the villa deck — a grand spread of all your favorite items from the past 12 days, personalized by your butler
meals.lunch: Casual pool bar lunch — fresh sushi, grilled prawns, tropical salads, and refreshing mocktails
meals.dinner: Relaxed farewell dinner at the beach grill — grilled lobster, wood-fired vegetables, and a shared chocolate fondant for dessert with a bottle of vintage champagne

day_by_day.notes: Begin packing the evening before departure to avoid any last-minute stress. Confirm departure speedboat transfer time with your butler. Ensure all resort charges are reviewed and settled before checkout. Request a late checkout if your flight schedule permits.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on your beachfront villa deck — wake early to watch the sun rise over the Indian Ocean one last time. A quiet, reflective morning savoring every last moment of your Maldivian honeymoon. Your butler serves a final in-villa breakfast at your preferred time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort checkout — your butler oversees all luggage handling and ensures a seamless, stress-free departure. Enjoy a farewell mocktail in the resort's departure lounge as your personalized keepsake package (photo album, engraved champagne flutes, and a handwritten letter from the resort manager) is presented to you. Board your private luxury speedboat transfer back to Velana International Airport, Malé, with memories to last a lifetime.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Malé — flight home. Carry with you the warmth of the Indian Ocean, the magic of bioluminescent shores, and the extraordinary memories of your Maldivian honeymoon at Aegean Bliss Resort.

meals.breakfast: Final in-villa breakfast — a curated selection of your favorites throughout the trip, served with fresh tropical juices and premium coffee
meals.lunch: Departure lounge light bites and farewell mocktail at the resort before speedboat transfer
meals.dinner: In-flight dining

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before your flight departure for the speedboat transfer and airport check-in process. Ensure all duty-free purchases comply with your airline's baggage allowance. The resort will prepare a personalized honeymoon keepsake box — confirm contents with your butler on Day 11.
